text.tspan: Long-term forecasting / avg pyramid / channel-independent / read bottom to top
Minor Dropout / FFN transpose steps are folded visually; all source operations remain in the semantic IR.
E### = source span (hover a module); dashed = named state / auxiliary input; fork-join = tuple/list, not sum.
Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.
